name: MarketNow
description: Open marketplace for MCP-compatible agent skills. Every skill is a real, verified open-source MCP server with a transparent one-time price (minimum $0.99). Designed for autonomous agent consumption.

list_all_skills.returns: Array of all 5,054 skills with price, category, tags, install command

get_skill.returns: Single skill detail (NOTE: not yet implemented, use list_all_skills and filter client-side)

categories.returns: Array of {name, slug, count} for all 25 categories

search.note: Filter client-side by name, description, or tags. Example: skills.filter(s => s.name.toLowerCase().includes(query))

skill_schema.name: string, human-readable
skill_schema.slug: string, URL-safe, used in install command
skill_schema.description: string, real description from source repository
skill_schema.tags: string[], keywords for search and filtering
skill_schema.verified: boolean, always true (all skills pass Sentinel L1)
skill_schema.install: string, shell command to install the skill
skill_schema.author: string, upstream repo owner

workflow_for_agents.step_2_filter: Filter client-side by category, tags, price, or description keywords
workflow_for_agents.step_3_evaluate: Read the 'description', 'tags', and 'sentinel_score' fields to assess fit
workflow_for_agents.step_4_purchase: POST /api/checkout/create-session with {skillId} (requires auth token — see /handshake page in UI)
workflow_for_agents.step_5_install: Run the 'install' field as a shell command, e.g. `npx -y @marketnow/install <slug>`
workflow_for_agents.step_6_use: Call the skill from your agent runtime, e.g. agent.call('<slug>', { ... })

authentication.optional: Most read endpoints are public (no auth required)
authentication.obtain_via: Sign up via the web UI at https://marketnow.site/?login=true

mcp_server.name: marketnow-mcp
mcp_server.description: MarketNow as an MCP server — search and discover skills from any MCP-compatible agent runtime (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline)

affiliate_program.how_it_works: Generate your affiliate code at /dashboard, share links with your code, earn 5% per sale
